mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal funds rate at 3.62% as of t-1mo
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Unemployment rate at 5.1% as of t-1mo
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases where UNRATE < 5.0%, or the mean return in such cases is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 2.0 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Residential construction at 2009.0 thousand units as of t-2mo
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances where HOUST > 2000.0, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 117.0 index points signals weakening real economic activity and declining corporate output, which reduces earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Industrial production at 118.016 as of t-1mo
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases where INDPRO < 117.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both personal consumption expenditures and residential investment signals strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances where both PAYEMS and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL combined with a stable or rising FEDFUNDS rate signals persistent inflationary pressure that triggers forward-looking equity risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 198.0 and FEDFUNDS >= 3.5%, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment growth and a decline in unemployment rate signals a labor market tightening that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k and UNRATE decreases > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises > 100k and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals strong underlying demand momentum that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 50% of instances where both RSAFS and GDPC1 are rising, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
